name: What is the typical process for getting noise-reducing windows installed by City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for getting noise-reducing windows installed by City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process at City Dweller, LLC typically begins with a free, no-obligation consultation at your property. We assess your current windows, discuss your noise concerns, and present suitable noise-reducing window options tailored to your home and budget. After you select your windows, we provide a detailed quote and timeline. Upon agreement, we handle all ordering and scheduling. Our experienced team then professionally installs the new windows, ensuring proper sealing and finishing. Finally, we conduct a walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction and provide any necessary follow-up.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial consultation, selection of window options, detailed quote, scheduling, professional installation, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
